note: Judge with a blind LLM judge on the strongest model available, comparing against a no-skill baseline. The judge writes the obvious pool first, then scores novelty, value, diversity, specificity and honesty (spot-checking 2+ prior-art or collision claims with web search). Show each pair to the judge in both orders and count a verdict only when both agree; use 3+ samples per arm before calling a close result.
